movie.title: Kissing Is the Easy Part
movie.overview: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When ambitious MIT hopeful Sean strikes a secret deal with the tenured parents of free-spirited Flora, an unexpected romance emerges that forces both teenagers to reevaluate their futures.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Sean is a high-achieving student laser-focused on earning a spot at MIT, while Flora is a rebel planning to skip the SATs entirely. In an attempt to keep Flora on an academic track, her tenured professor parents strike a secret deal with Sean to influence her. As the two spend more time together, their initial friction transforms into a genuine romantic connection that forces them to question everything they believe in.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by intense ambition, Sean has mapped out his entire future around getting accepted into MIT, viewing academic perfection as his only path to success. Flora, on the other hand, rejects the hyper-competitive academic pressure imposed by her tenured professor parents and plans to ditch the SATs entirely. Desperate to ensure their daughter stays on a traditional track, Flora's parents secretly enlist Sean to motivate her under the guise of peer support. What begins as a transactional agreement quickly becomes complicated as Sean and Flora discover a deep, mutual connection beneath their contrasting worldviews. Through their growing intimacy, Flora learns to articulate her authentic desires, while Sean realizes that life extends far beyond test scores and institutional prestige. Their blossoming romance challenges their core beliefs about success, obligation, and family expectations. However, the hidden arrangement constantly threatens to unravel the trust they have built between them. Ultimately, both teenagers must navigate the fallout of secrets and decide what true success means on their own terms.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Kissing Is the Easy Part is a romantic comedy-drama that explores the collision of high academic expectations, youth rebellion, and genuine connection. The story follows Sean, a disciplined high school senior whose ultimate dream is admission to MIT, and Flora, an independent thinker who resists her family's academic legacy by refusing to take the SATs. Caught between her desire for freedom and her tenured parents' vision for her future, Flora becomes the center of a secret deal between her parents and Sean. As Sean balances his ambition with his growing affection for Flora, both teenagers navigate the delicate boundaries between parental pressure, personal identity, and young love.

story_structure.climax: The truth behind their arrangement and the friction between their divergent paths reach a high-stakes breaking point, forcing both to make a decisive choice.
story_structure.conflict: Sean enters into a secret arrangement with Flora's tenured parents, tying his future goals directly to her, despite their initial clash in values.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the confrontation, Sean and Flora confront their true desires, redefining what happiness and their futures look like beyond expectations.
story_structure.introduction: Driven MIT-hopeful Sean and academic-rebel Flora navigate high-stakes high school life with completely opposing priorities.
story_structure.risingAction: As they carry out their deal, a genuine romantic connection blossoms, complicating their motivations and challenging what each believes about success, pressure, and romance.
